stage_policy.syntax: All fixtures must be accepted by `langc check --syntax-only --format json`.
stage_policy.names: All fixtures must be accepted by `lang_module_check` on their lang.toml; reject cases must fail for a type/effect reason, not a misspelled name or import.
stage_policy.type_check: Expected accept/reject is derived from the cited specification. `unavailable` means the construct belongs to T07, T08 or T09 and expects the published E_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE, not a T04 static type error.
stage_policy.diagnostic_codes: Unavailable cases bind only the published E_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE. T04-specific reject/accept codes are not bound because they are not published.

source.clause: 实现 `bool`、`i8/i16/i32/i64`、`u8/u16/u32/u64`、`isize/usize`、`f32/f64`、`string`、`Unit`。

core_numeric_positive.reason: Fixed-width scalar types and explicit local types are the T04 scalar core.

source.clause: 整数和浮点字面量先保留未定类型常量。有上下文时检查目标类型，无上下文时默认 i64/f64。

local_literal_default_i64.reason: An unconstrained integer literal defaults to i64; an explicit i64 context is therefore valid.

source.clause: 负整数字面量在完成一元负号语义后检查范围，允许最小负整数；不能在 lexer 中先把正数字面量塞进宿主 i64。

explicit_negative_minimum.reason: The minimum negative i32 value is legal when the unary minus and target range are checked together.

source.clause: 字面量超出目标类型范围与已定类型表达式运算回绕不同：`let x i8 = 128;` 是静态错误；`let x i8 = 127; let y = x + 1;` 得到 -128。常量折叠必须复用同一套数值规则。

i8_boundary_and_wrap.reason: i8=127 and i8=-128 are representable; an already-i8 expression wraps at runtime instead of becoming a literal-range error.

source.clause: 字面量超出目标类型范围与已定类型表达式运算回绕不同：`let x i8 = 128;` 是静态错误；`let x i8 = 127; let y = x + 1;` 得到 -128。常量折叠必须复用同一套数值规则。

literal_out_of_range.reason: 128 and -129 are outside the i8 range and are rejected before any runtime wrap.

source.clause: 变量之间不隐式混合有符号、无符号、不同位宽或整数与浮点；字面量可以受上下文约束。赋值、实参、返回值均使用这一规则。

no_implicit_mixed_width.reason: The inferred i64 and explicit i32 are already-determined variables; no common width is inferred implicitly.

source.clause: 变量之间不隐式混合有符号、无符号、不同位宽或整数与浮点；字面量可以受上下文约束。赋值、实参、返回值均使用这一规则。

no_signed_unsigned_mix.reason: i32 and u32 have different signedness; both operands are variables, so no implicit conversion is applied.

source.clause: 变量之间不隐式混合有符号、无符号、不同位宽或整数与浮点；字面量可以受上下文约束。赋值、实参、返回值均使用这一规则。

no_integer_float_mix.reason: i32 and f64 are different numeric families; integer-to-float conversion must be explicit.

source.clause: `if/for` 条件必须是 bool。赋值不是表达式，没有隐式真假转换。

bool_condition_only.reason: The if condition is an integer literal, not bool; there is no implicit truthiness conversion.

source.clause: `let` 禁止重新绑定和修改本语言值字段；引用对象允许通过已声明的可变操作修改内部状态。

let_not_reassignable.reason: Assigning to a let-bound local is a rebinding even when the value type is unchanged.

source.clause: `var`：绑定可以重新赋值。

var_reassignable.reason: A var local can be assigned and compound-assigned while retaining its declared type.

source.clause: 赋值、实参、返回值均使用这一规则。

return_type_checked.reason: The function declares i32 but returns a bool expression; returns obey the no-implicit-conversion rule.

all_paths_return.reason: When flag is false, control reaches the end of an i32 function without a return value.

source.clause: 第一版仅接受可证明无别名的 `var` 整体绑定，类型限定为数值/bool 或递归只含平凡值的 struct/enum；引用容器、外部对象、字段/索引位置的 inout 明确报未支持。

inout_writable_var.reason: An i32 local declared with var is a writable whole binding; the parameter and call-site inout annotations agree.

source.clause: 第一版仅接受可证明无别名的 `var` 整体绑定，类型限定为数值/bool 或递归只含平凡值的 struct/enum；引用容器、外部对象、字段/索引位置的 inout 明确报未支持。

inout_requires_writable_var.reason: A let binding is known not to be a writable var whole binding. FRONTEND 7.3 makes this a static place/writability rejection in T04; T09 covers alias, escape and ARC, not this known-unwritable argument.

supporting_sources.clause: 第一版 `inout` 仅接受可写的平凡值整变量绑定（类型限制见 SEMANTICS），不接受引用容器、外部对象、字段、索引或带复杂别名的位置；独占、逃逸和 `move` 规则见 `SEMANTICS.md`。

source.clause: native 第一版采用单态化，缓存键包括泛型声明身份和规范化类型实参。

generic_stage_unavailable.reason: Generic declaration and instantiation are T07 work; T04 must not accept the call with Any or an ad-hoc instance.

source.clause: 增加 native Vec 与包含拥有成员的聚合类型清理；资源失败注入必须覆盖部分构造状态。

vec_stage_unavailable.reason: Vec[i32] and its list initializer require aggregate/Vec work outside the T04 scalar core; T04 must not model it as an arbitrary Any value.

throws_stage_unavailable.reason: Typed throws, throw and effect propagation are T08 work; the fixture is not a T04 type error.

constant_integer_conversion_range.reason: A source constant i8(300) must be rejected before constructing typed HIR; the dynamic IntegerConvert operation retains runtime range checks.

unresolved_semantics.current_text: SEMANTICS §2 fixes parameter scope but does not state whether an ordinary (non-inout) parameter is reassignable; §7.2 only defines inout and move access.

expected.reason: Scalar boundaries, an explicit negative minimum, default-i64 inference, fixed-width i8 wrapping, var assignment and a direct call are all legal T04 scalar constructs.
128 is above i8's maximum and -129 is below its minimum; both are literal range errors, not runtime wraps.
The unconstrained `inferred` is i64; adding the explicit i32 `narrow` is a mixed-width operation with no implicit common type.
i32 and u32 are both determined variables, so their signedness cannot be unified implicitly.
An i32 variable and an f64 variable cannot be mixed without an explicit conversion.
The if condition is an integer rather than bool; the language has no implicit truthiness.
A let binding cannot be reassigned, regardless of whether the new value has the same type.
A var i32 is writable; plain assignment and compound assignment preserve the scalar type.
The declared return type is i32 while the return expression is bool; a return value is not implicitly converted.
The false branch of the if reaches the end of an i32 function without returning a value.
add requires both a and b, but the call supplies only one positional argument.
left is not a parameter of the directly called add; a is also missing. Positional-then-named syntax itself is legal.
The positional 1 already binds a, then `a: 2` provides the same parameter again; b is missing.
A direct function call uses known named arguments in reordered form, while a function value call uses only positional arguments.
op has function type, not a direct function declaration; function types carry parameter modes, result and throws but not parameter labels.
The argument is a whole writable var i32 and the call-site inout marker matches the parameter mode. Exclusivity and escape checks remain T09 work.
The syntax and names are valid, but checking/instantiating the generic function requires T07. T04 must not bypass it with Any.
Vec[i32] and its list initializer are outside the T04 scalar core. The fixture is syntactically and name-valid, but the type capability is unavailable until the aggregate/Vec work.
The throws declaration, throw expression and propagation are syntactically and name-valid, but typed effect checking belongs to T08.
The let binding is not a writable var whole binding; T04 rejects the known-unwritable inout argument. Alias, escape and ARC checks remain T09, and no unpublished T04 code is bound.
300 is a compile-time integer constant outside i8; this is a source type error.
